puzzle_ch1_power.title: EMERGENCY POWER ROUTING
puzzle_ch1_power.description: Route backup current through the critical life-support chain while isolating weapons.
puzzle_ch1_power.clue: Schematic: 'Battery first, regulator second, pressure relay last. Do NOT feed the weapon grid.'

puzzle_ch2_keypad.title: MEDICAL BAY EMERGENCY LOCKER
puzzle_ch2_keypad.description: Enter the 3-digit security code derived from patient admission records.
puzzle_ch2_keypad.clue: Note: 'Chronological admission timestamps: 03:15, 07:40, 11:05. The final digits identify the emergency locker.'

puzzle_ch3_valves.title: BIOHAZARD ISOLATION VALVES
puzzle_ch3_valves.description: Isolate the contaminated branches in the correct safety order before toxic radiation vents.
puzzle_ch3_valves.clue: Safety Protocol: '1. Laboratory Ventilation [HELIX] -> 2. Containment Chamber [CIRCLE] -> 3. Reactor Cooling [FLAME] -> 4. Engage Seal.'

puzzle_ch4_matrix.title: DEFENSE MATRIX REPROGRAMMING
puzzle_ch4_matrix.description: Bypass autonomous sentry targeting by configuring all three security authorization layers.
puzzle_ch4_matrix.clue: Ward's Security Logs: Identity Voss-9442 as dead, Command Ward-Halt-09, Target Isolate Core.

puzzle_ch5_transceiver.title: ORBITAL TRANSCEIVER ARRAY ALIGNMENT
puzzle_ch5_transceiver.description: Align all three satellite dishes with the deep-space fleet relay coordinates.

puzzle_ch5_sera_harmonic.title: QUANTUM HARMONIC RESONANCE SYNCHRONIZER
puzzle_ch5_sera_harmonic.description: Tune three quantum resonance harmonics to stabilize Dr. Sera Nahl's holographic consciousness.
puzzle_ch5_sera_harmonic.clue: Veyr Frequency Blueprint: Harmonic ratio 1:2:3 tuned to base 420 Hz.

puzzle_ch6_directive.title: THE CONTINUUM ENGINE: PRIME DIRECTIVE CONSOLE
puzzle_ch6_directive.description: Input the final operational directive to determine the causal fate of the universe.

options.name: DIRECTIVE A: PRESERVE [SYSTEM REBOOT]
options.summary: Reboot the Aegis-9 and purge the Watcher. The existing universe is preserved with free will. 48 lost star systems remain erased.

options.name: DIRECTIVE B: MERGE [TRANSCENDENT SACRIFICE]
options.summary: Integrate Clara's consciousness with the Continuum Engine. Replace the Watcher's nihilistic calculus with human empathy.

options.name: DIRECTIVE C: ISOLATE [TOTAL TERMINATION]
options.summary: Sever all reactor couplings and isolate the Engine from the cosmos forever. The starless void remains.

options.name: SECRET DIRECTIVE: TRANSMIT & REMEMBER [THE UNIVERSE REMEMBERS]
options.summary: Transmit the compressed archive of all 48 erased star systems across deep space before shutting down the Engine.
